baseListing.description:
Notai is a calm, collaborative notes app with sticky-note windows that float above every other window. Designed for ADHD-friendly thinking: capture an idea, draw on it, share it in real time, and never lose it.

Features:
- Realtime collaborative notes powered by CRDTs
- Always-on-top sticky note windows
- Drawing canvas with pressure-sensitive ink
- PDF import & annotation
- Cross-device sync
- Offline-first; your work is never lost
- Privacy-respecting; your data is yours
baseListing.shortDescription: Calm, collaborative notes with sticky-note windows that float above everything else.
